programmes.evidence: The entire official programme page explicitly identifies the academic award Doctor en Ciencias de la Ingeniería, original independent frontier research in Industrial and Transportation Engineering, required approved doctoral thesis and degree examination, and eight-semester programme. Two formal research lines cover planning/management/optimization of logistics/economic systems and design/planning/regulation of complex systems, including uncertain logistics networks, ports, aircraft networks, rosters and resource allocation.
